The '''Ubrikkian Trade Tower''' was a large structure in the center of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was the headquarters of [[Ubrikkian Transports/Legends|Ubrikkian Transports]]. The building was located in the largest intersection in town where [[Outer Curved Street/Legends|Outer Curved Street]], [[Spacers Row/Legends|Spacers Row]], and [[Straight Street/Legends|Straight Street]] intersected. It was also the tallest building in the spaceport.
